parameters.jsCode: const event=$input.first().json; const description=String(event.description||''); const pairs=Object.fromEntries([...description.matchAll(/^\s*([A-Z_]+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$/gm)].map((m)=>[m[1],m[2]])); const contentId=pairs.CONTENT_ID; const start=event.start?.dateTime||event.start?.date; if(!String(event.summary||'').startsWith('PRE-POST |')||pairs.STATUS!=='READY'||!contentId||!start||new Date(start)>new Date()) return []; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.content=store.content||{}; const prior=store.content[contentId]; if(prior?.status==='published'||prior?.status==='awaiting_approval'||prior?.status==='approved') return []; const required=['PLATFORM','TOPIC','AUDIENCE','GOAL','CTA','WEBSITE','APPROVAL_REQUIRED','STATUS']; const missing=required.filter((key)=>!pairs[key]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Calendar event '+(event.id||'unknown')+' is missing: '+missing.join(', ')); store.content[contentId]={status:'generating',eventId:event.id,startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),retries:(prior?.retries||0)}; return [{json:{contentId,eventId:event.id,start,platform:pairs.PLATFORM.toLowerCase(),topic:pairs.TOPIC,audience:pairs.AUDIENCE,goal:pairs.GOAL,cta:pairs.CTA,website:pairs.WEBSITE,approvalRequired:pairs.APPROVAL_REQUIRED,sourceDescription:description}}];

parameters.jsCode: const token=$input.first().json.query?.token; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const record=store.approvals?.[token]; if(!record||record.expiresAt<Date.now()||record.status!=='pending') throw new Error('This approval link is invalid, expired, or already used.'); record.status='rejected'; store.content[record.contentId]={...(store.content[record.contentId]||{}),status:'rejected',updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}; return [{json:{contentId:record.contentId,status:'rejected'}}];

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;

const prompt = [
  'Create a LinkedIn post for Ellis AI Studio.',
  '',
  'Business positioning:',
  'Ellis AI Studio identifies business problems and builds AI-powered',
  'solutions that save time, reduce costs, and help businesses grow.',
  '',
  `Topic: ${item.topic}`,
  `Audience: ${item.audience}`,
  `Goal: ${item.goal}`,
  `Call to action: ${item.cta}`,
  `Website: ${item.website}`,
  '',
  'Requirements:',
  '- Start with a strong business-problem hook.',
  '- Use clear, confident language.',
  '- Keep the post between 120 and 220 words.',
  '- Focus on business outcomes, not proprietary workflow details.',
  '- Do not invent statistics, customers, testimonials, or results.',
  '- Use short readable paragraphs.',
  '- Include no more than four relevant hashtags.',
  '- End with the requested call to action.',
  '- Return only the finished LinkedIn post.'
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ...item,
    openaiRequestBody: {
      model: item.openaiModel || 'gpt-5-mini',
      input: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'input_text', text: prompt }] }]
    }
  }
}];

Repeating the same admin tasks every day is quietly draining your time, cash, and growth potential.

Automate these three repetitive tasks today and free up your team to focus on revenue-generating work.

Invoicing and payment follow-ups — automated invoices and reminders speed collections, improve cash flow, and cut chase time.
Customer messages and FAQs — AI triage handles common questions, routes high-value issues to humans, and keeps response times fast.
Scheduling and confirmations — self-service booking and automated reminders reduce no-shows and eliminate back-and-forth.

These automations reduce manual errors, lower operating costs, and give customers a faster, more consistent experience—without replacing your people.

If you want help identifying which tasks to automate first and building a solution that delivers measurable business results, we can help. Learn more: https://ellisaistudio.com
